decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet system is the next generation of REA JET's core marking technology, and its prominent launch on the home page shows strong related knowledge and commitment.
The numbering software module extends the firm's established variable-data printing software portfolio, so it fits existing competence and costs little to maintain.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces applies the firm's core coding know-how to adjacent substrates, so the firm can interpret customer feedback and improve the product.
The CodeScan app succeeds PharmaScan and complements REA's code verification expertise, though as a free app it lies further from the core hardware business and is more easily replaced.
Inline code verification builds directly on REA's verification and marking knowledge and creates synergies with its coders, which supports keeping it.
Layout design software is integral to operating the firm's printers and was featured on the home page, so it draws on existing software competence.
